Required protective sufficiency may increase where evidenced developmental vulnerability, capacity limitation, temporary or situational consent impairment, acute distress, cognitive asymmetry, or comparable protection conditions materially affect the risk, but disability or neurodivergence alone must not be treated as incapacity.
